title: Undeciphered: the Isthmian script
summary: It is not settled whether this early Mesoamerican script, best known from La Mojarra Stela 1, is a true writing system. A 1993 partial decipherment remains disputed and unproven.
why: It could be one of the Americas' earliest readable voices.
question: Is the Isthmian script true writing, and does it record a Zoquean language?
evidence: Longest text on La Mojarra Stela 1; Justeson and Kaufman proposed Zoquean readings in 1993; Houston and Coe disputed them; Robinson (2008) called the decipherment unproven.
wouldSettle: New Isthmian texts on which the proposed Zoquean readings correctly predict meaningful content.

theories.name: Zoquean-language writing
theories.idea: Justeson and Kaufman proposed the La Mojarra text encodes an early Zoquean language.

theories.name: Decipherment unproven
theories.idea: Houston and Coe disputed that reading; critics say it rests on shaky foundations.
